options_evaluated: Monomaterial PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) polycarbonate/ABS blend without overmolding
Glass-fiber reinforced polyamide with overmolded TPE grips
Bio-based composite housing with co-molded rubber grips
assessments.recommendation: Monomaterial PCR (Post-Consumer Recycled) polycarbonate/ABS blend without overmolding
assessments.rationale: Using a monomaterial PCR PC/ABS blend without overmolding maximizes the ease and quality of recycling (d) by avoiding multi-material contamination (such as TPE on PA6-GF). Eliminating overmolding prevents the release of microplastics during shredding (p) and ensures the housing can be easily reprocessed into high-quality secondary raw materials, minimizing waste generated in end-of-life treatment (r).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: User Experience and Durability: Overmolded TPE grips provide superior ergonomic comfort and impact resistance, which may be compromised by a strict monomaterial design.

options_evaluated: Reversible mechanical fasteners (screws with metal inserts)
assessments.recommendation: Reversible mechanical fasteners (screws with metal inserts)
assessments.rationale: Reversible fasteners allow non-destructive disassembly, dramatically improving the ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (c). It avoids the use of adhesives or permanent welds that act as solutions detrimental to recycling (e) and increases the ease and quality of recycling (d) by allowing clean separation of plastics, metals, and electronics. This reduces the energy and resources consumed in EoL treatment (g) and minimizes EoL waste (r).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing and Cost: Reversible fasteners and metal inserts increase assembly time, bill of materials (BOM) cost, and manufacturing complexity compared to rapid ultrasonic welding.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC motor with modular, non-glued neodymium magnets
Brushed DC motor with integrated gearbox
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC motor with modular, non-glued neodymium magnets
assessments.rationale: A brushless motor with non-glued magnets facilitates the easy extraction and recovery of critical raw materials (neodymium) at end-of-life, directly supporting high-quality recycling (d) and avoiding solutions detrimental to recovery (e). The brushless design also has a longer operational lifespan, enhancing the potential for component reuse and remanufacturing (c).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Sourcing and Initial Cost: Brushless motors with rare-earth magnets are significantly more expensive to source and manufacture than simple brushed DC motors.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via aluminum heatsink with mechanical attachment
Active fan cooling with integrated plastic ducting
assessments.recommendation: Passive cooling via aluminum heatsink with mechanical attachment
assessments.rationale: A mechanically attached aluminum heatsink can be easily separated from the electronics at EoL, ensuring high-quality recycling of both the aluminum and the printed circuit board (d). Thermal potting or encapsulation is highly detrimental to recycling (e) as it permanently bonds materials, rendering the electronics unrecyclable and increasing the environmental footprint and waste generated in end-of-life treatment (m, r).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Reliability and Environmental Protection: Thermal potting compounds provide excellent dust and moisture protection (IP rating), which protects the electronics from harsh environment failures.

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with slide-in, toolless swappable sub-assemblies (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
assessments.recommendation: Fully modular architecture with slide-in, toolless swappable sub-assemblies (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
assessments.rationale: A fully modular, toolless architecture maximizes the ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing, and refurbishment (c) by allowing users or technicians to replace only the failed module. At EoL, it enables rapid, low-energy manual sorting of distinct material streams (plastics, metals, e-waste), optimizing the ease and quality of recycling (d) and reducing EoL processing energy (g).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Physical Design and Compactness: Modular slide-in connections require additional internal structural housing, connectors, and volume, resulting in a bulkier and heavier tool.

options_evaluated: Removable, standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with screw-fastened casing
Integrated, pouch-cell Li-ion battery glued inside the handle
assessments.recommendation: Removable, standardized slide-on Li-ion battery pack with screw-fastened casing
assessments.rationale: A removable, screw-fastened battery pack allows safe extraction prior to EoL processing, preventing thermal events during shredding and ensuring high-quality recycling of both the battery and the tool (d). It avoids solutions detrimental to recycling (e) like glued-in cells, facilitates battery pack refurbishment (c), and ensures that the battery cells can be recovered with minimal environmental footprint (m) and waste (r).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Ergonomics and Industrial Design: An integrated battery allows for a much slimmer, lighter, and more balanced handle design, improving user comfort during prolonged use.
